claims.evidence_quote: Consider a complete network of n processors with at least ⌈αn⌉ non-faulty processors and CONGEST communication model.

claims.subject: iFTDTC
claims.evidence_quote: Then there is an implicit Fault-Tolerant Distributed Trigger Counting (iFTDTC) algorithm which raises an alert when the triggers received by the non-faulty processors are at least w in O(n1∕2 log5∕2 n log w∕α5∕2) messages with high probability.

claims.subject: Phase 1
claims.evidence_quote: Phase 1 performs O(log w) iterations as the threshold τ is halved each time.

claims.subject: Phase 2
claims.evidence_quote: In the case of phase 2, whenever a processor receives the trigger, the committee processor sends the trigger to the other committee processors via referee processors, which may take O((n ln n∕α)1∕2(ln n∕α)) messages.
